facts.value: Act 161 of 2016: wages may be paid by credit to a financial-institution account including a payroll card account if the employee authorized it in writing or electronically; employer provides a written or electronic statement of earnings and deductions each pay period; payroll card rules (Reg E card, FDIC/NCUA insured, not a condition of employment, notice of options, switch to direct deposit by the first payday after 14 days).
Phila. Code 9-4104: 1 hour per 40 hours worked in Philadelphia, cap 40 hours per calendar year unless a higher limit is chosen, use from the 90th calendar day, overtime-exempt assumed 40 h/week.

facts.value: PA DOR Letter Ruling PIT-06-005 (2006-04-12): employer HSA contributions and HSA elections made through a Section 125 cafeteria plan are excluded from compensation (no withholding); other employee HSA contributions are not exempt (withholding applies). A later superseding ruling was not searched.

LTEA section 501 (as amended by Act 18 of 2018): local earned income = compensation as required to be reported to or determined by PA Revenue under section 303 of the Tax Reform Code, i.e. the same compensation base as PA PIT. DCED register cadence was not verified (stays open as a sub-point).

facts.value: 23 Pa.C.S. 4348: employer implements within 14 days of notice; remits to the domestic relations section or State disbursement unit within seven business days of the pay date; one-time employer fee 50 USD (not deducted from the support amount); limits per the Consumer Credit Protection Act; employer liable for amounts willfully not withheld.
